goal: Scope secondary index ownership to node instances instead of process-global singletons.
Cleanly encapsulates node state and unblocks running multiple node instances in tests and IPC.
agreement: Concept approval without stated reasons (sedited, fjahr)
Nonblocking suggestion to use standard smart pointers without custom deleters (fjahr)

categories.name: indexes
why: P3 because it encapsulates index lifecycles into node instances rather than process-wide globals.
Helps decouple index components and unblocks future multiprocess work without changing user behavior.
